selected_equipment: Onset M-TPB two-metre tripod with M-GWA, M-GKA, M-SKA and M-SKB accessories

notes: Two-metre model has nonadjustable legs; do not copy the three-metre adjustable legs or ground-level brace assembly.
Lower mast has north/south creases; upper mast has an indexing dimple and overlaps the lower section. A 1-5/8 inch U-bolt assembly clamps the splice just above the dimple.
Three 1/4-inch stakes or concrete anchors secure the feet. Wind-sensor installation uses guy wires; the two-metre guy kit uses separate 1/2-inch stakes.
Guy kit includes upper tri-clamp with eyebolts, wire clamps, S hooks and turnbuckles. Tension and ground capacity are not provided by geometry.

Manufacturer suggests temporary ordinary cable ties to hold the upper mast beside a tripod leg during sensor assembly, and recommends two people for joining mast sections. One-G1 handling remains unqualified.
The footprint datum is unspecified. A selected 0.51 m centre-to-foot radius is an explicit conservative spatial hypothesis, not a recovered manufacturer dimension.
No exact reusable manufacturer CAD was obtained from the recorded official-site CAD/STEP and dimensional searches.
Coated outside diameter, individual strand arrangement and tension rating are not given on the product page.
Rod diameter, ground-wire length and clamp dimensions remain unspecified.
Mast level listed as discontinued at inspection; exact availability and alternative ordinary level remain open.
